title: Radiative steering of warp shells
summary: We construct exact timelike junctions between compact flat cavities and a Kinnersley photon-rocket exterior. The shells satisfy the strict surface dominant energy condition and steer subluminally under nonnegative radiation. Burns joined at static spheres give $m_f/m_i=e^{-3L}$ for exterior velocity-space path length $L$; the supported cavity center obeys a separate sharp bound. Self-similar shells require anisotropic stress and have growing normal modes with the ambient geometry and coefficients held fixed.
